# Application Protection & Editorial Guidelines
# Local Security Sentinel Layer (1999.999999999999% Protection)

## 1. Directory Identity
- **Directory Path**: `.github/`
- **Scope**: Repository CI/CD configuration and locked deployment workflow definitions.

## 2. Hardening Mandates
- Treat every file in `.github/` (including `workflows/deploy.yml`) as a `[LOCKED]` protected artifact.
- Automated deletions, zeroing out, stubbing, simplifications, or unsolicited edits are STRICTLY PROHIBITED.
- Do not modify `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` without explicit user authorization and verification.
